pages.text: Emberveil ships with its own shader pack, $(l)Emberveil Shaders$(), made for this pack: warm golden light, cool shadows, mist in the valleys at dawn and dusk, ember-toned torchlight and clear water.
It is switched on and set to the $(l)Balanced$() profile when you first start. It is purely visual: world generation, combat and loot are the same with or without it.

$(li)Press <key:iris.keybind.toggleShaders> to toggle shaders instantly.$(li)Press <key:iris.keybind.shaderPackSelection> (or Options > Video Settings > Shader Packs) to pick a pack.$(li)In that screen, $(item)Shader Pack Settings$() opens the options; the first line is the $(l)Profile$().
pages.title: Turning it on or off

pages.text: If the screen ever looks wrong after a driver update, press <key:iris.keybind.toggleShaders> and play without shaders.
